claim: Try a populated sample without changing your own plan.
sandbox: Fresh /demo context with a separate real-plan key; add a sample slice, reset, leave demo, and assert the real key is unchanged.

claim: Import MusicXML, XML, or MXL files up to 25 MB.
sandbox: Fresh /demo context; import a compressed MXL, reject a 25 MiB plus one byte XML file, then recover with XML.

claim: Keep scores in the browser during free use.
sandbox: Fresh /demo browser context records every request through a sample planning action and checks only same-origin requests and demo-only storage.

claim: Choose the score part for the rehearsal queue.
sandbox: Fresh /demo context changes from clarinet to cello and checks the displayed part, measure count, and reset queue.

claim: Set the free sightline to eight measures.
sandbox: Fresh /demo context moves to the opening and sets look-ahead to eight; eight rendered measure tiles are required.

claim: Step through measures with the keyboard.
sandbox: Fresh /demo context sends ArrowRight and Shift+ArrowRight to the reading surface and checks the visible measure.

claim: Mark a range with a name, note, and result.
sandbox: Fresh /demo context adds a named range with a note, marks it Passed, and checks the saved card outcome.
Fresh /demo context applies print media and requires all four sample ranges on the cue sheet.

claim: Export and import a portable plan backup.
sandbox: Fresh /demo context downloads a plan, checks its portable format and ranges, then imports it back.

claim: Keep a demo plan until it is reset.
sandbox: Fresh /demo context adds a range, reloads, and checks the range and demo storage remain.

claim: Work offline after the first visit.
sandbox: Dedicated fresh browser context loads /demo under service-worker control, goes offline, reloads, and checks the populated workspace.

claim: Use planning, cue sheets, and backups without a Studio license.
sandbox: Fresh /demo context without a license adds a range, enables the cue sheet, and exposes backup export.

claim: Restore a Studio license on another device.
sandbox: Fresh /demo context blocks service workers, uses a recorded valid billing response, restores a token, and checks the 16-measure and tempo outcomes.

claim: Check a Studio license at most once per day.
sandbox: Fresh /demo context uses a recorded valid billing response, reloads within one day without another check, then ages the recorded verdict and requires one check.

claim: Avoid a broken checkout while Studio registration is pending.
sandbox: Fresh /demo context verifies there is no checkout link or billing request before an explicit license restore.
